release.label: HERUS Grand Finale pre-hardware release candidate

gates.question: Does the actual LilyGO T3-S3 revision match the verified pin map?
gates.claim_if_pass: The board-specific HAL mapping may be used for the measured bench.

gates.question: Does the 30x30x10 mm stack close within the pre-committed height gate?
gates.claim_if_pass: The tested stack fits the stated shell revision only.

gates.question: Do two boards exchange clean ranger CSV rows at one metre?
gates.claim_if_pass: The tested boards establish the defined short-range radio baseline.

gates.question: Does the pre-registered urban walk satisfy its PDR gate?
gates.claim_if_pass: Only the measured route, conditions and board revision have the recorded PDR.

gates.question: Does the header-less Tier 0.5 hypothesis survive the matched physical comparison?
gates.claim_if_pass: The measured comparison supports or rejects the Tier 0.5 hypothesis for that setup.

gates.question: Does an instrumented PMIC or bench measurement supply energy with a declared unit?
gates.claim_if_pass: The reported energy belongs only to the declared workload and instrument.

gates.question: Are button, local ASR, haptic adapter and confirmation behavior measured with the frozen A3 protocol?
gates.claim_if_pass: The measured interaction gate applies only to the declared protocol and population.

gates.question: Are protected storage, target RNG, transport association and revocation wired on the target?
gates.claim_if_pass: The tested target port supports the documented trust lifecycle for its revision.

gates.question: Does the selected collection backend recover every PREPARED/floor/COMMITTED/cleanup interruption to the state permitted by the portable recovery matrix?
gates.claim_if_pass: Only the declared backend revision and interruption method satisfy the recorded collection-recovery matrix.

gates.question: Does the selected adapter demonstrate purpose binding, event provenance, monotonic-time/reset policy, boot quarantine, ID-exhaustion/rotation policy, cancellation and replay resistance for collection sessions under controlled interruption?
gates.claim_if_pass: Only the declared adapter revision and tested reset/interruption method satisfy the recorded collection-session, boot-quarantine and final-chain contract.

gates.question: Does a local model satisfy the A9 resource and agency acceptance contract on the target?
gates.claim_if_pass: Only the identified model/configuration satisfies the recorded target profile.
